mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level in the current month reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, compressing the cost of capital and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in the same window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS 1-month growth > 0.5%) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates economic overheating, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 2200 thousand units) during late-cycle expansions signals economic overheating and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 2200 during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) in the current month reflects stronger labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day S&P 500 returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing sector weakness and economic slowdown, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 3%) combined with high housing starts (HOUST > 2200) signals economic overheating, triggering anticipated monetary tightening that reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth > 3% and HOUST > 2200, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0 during high-inflation regimes, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
